billing_reconciliation.amendment_rationale: On an HTTP 500 error, no usage block is returned by the provider. Claiming $0.00 total monetary cost is unfounded because upstream gateways or GPU providers may still log or bill failed requests. Impact cannot be established without billing ledger access.

security_and_credential_audit.recommendation: Transition future benchmark runs to arbitrary Credential Source IDs (e.g. 'CRED_SOURCE_HCNSEC_CANDIDATE_01') completely decoupled from the underlying secret.
security_and_credential_audit.risk_assessment: Unsalted SHA-256 hashes of high-entropy API keys resist pre-image dictionary attacks, but do not provide unconditional security. They uniquely correlate credentials across repositories.
